messages: [04:53:48] Select an option: [I volunteered to be part of the Safety Squad.]
[04:53:51] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fThat's cool. I got here because I got into a scuffle with the Security Sloth.
[04:53:56] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fMan, I was so close to defeating the big guy, can't believe his backup came so fast!
[04:54:01] Select an option: [Wait, what?]
[04:54:05] [NPC] Brigette: §f§c§lSTOP RIGHT THERE!
[04:54:07] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThat's not a recruit, he's supposed to be a detainee!
[04:54:08] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fAw shucks, I was so close!
[04:54:10] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fI'll try again next time.
[04:54:13] [NPC] Jimmy: §f§fYou haven't seen the last of me!
[04:54:27] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI'm so sorry about putting you in danger like that.
[04:54:30] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fAre you alright?
[04:54:32] Select an option: [What just happened?]
[04:54:34] [NPC] Brigette: §f§9Jimmy§f is currently wanted for twelve counts of §cscamming§f and five more counts of assault.
[04:54:40] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWho knows what he could have done to you.
[04:54:43] [NPC] Brigette: §f§f...
[04:54:44] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fI heard you were going to trade with §9Jimmy§f?
[04:54:47] Select an option: [Yeah.]
[04:54:49] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fLucky for you, he couldn't pull off his §cscam§f within the §bSecurity Hall§f.
[04:54:54] [NPC] Brigette: §f§9Jimmy§f wanted you to trade outside so that he wouldn't get caught.
[04:54:58] Select an option: [How does this scam work?]
[04:55:02] [NPC] Brigette: §f§9Jimmy§f would show you his "very cool gauntlets" in the trading menu.
[04:55:06] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWhen you attempt to accept the trade, he would quickly swap it to something much cheaper.
[04:55:12] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf the trade goes through, you'd be stuck with the cheaper item!
[04:55:16] Select an option: [Yikes.]
[04:55:22] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThere are many other forms of these §cscams§f.
[04:55:25] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fSome people will set frequently used items up for §6§oauctions§f at a high price, hoping that someone accidentally clicks on them.
[04:55:33] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fSome people will pretend they can help you §c§lreforge§f§f something, then just steal your item once you handed it over to them.
[04:55:40] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThere's even scarier things, like someone telling you to click a link to join a §c§lgiveaway§f§f.
[04:55:45] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIt will ask you to enter your §bMicrosoft email§f and sends you a login code.
[04:55:50] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fIf you give them your code, you've just §llost§f your account entirely.
[04:55:55] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThere are a lot of §cscams§f lurking around every corner.
[04:55:58] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fWe try our best to prevent §cscams§f from happening, but §cscammers§f always come up with new tricks.
[04:56:04] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fThat's why it's always important to stay alert, and stay safe.
[04:56:08] [NPC] Brigette: §f§fBe especially wary of people you just met!
[04:56:09] [NPC] Brigette: §fAnyhow, that's all for today.
[04:56:11] [NPC] Brigette: §fI hope you've learnt quite a bit about account security.
[04:56:15] [NPC] Brigette: §fTo cap it off, we have a short quiz to recap what we just went through.
[04:56:20] [NPC] Brigette: §fAnswer a few questions, and you'll become a certified Safety Advocate!
[04:56:56] [NPC] Brigette: §a§lCorrect! §fIn fact, all of the listed statements are true - losing your account can mean lost items, money, profiles, or even your whole Microsoft account.
[04:57:27] [NPC] Brigette: §a§lYOU GOT IT! §fYou can report the player with the /report command, followed by the player's username.

[04:57:59] [NPC] Brigette: §a§lThat's right! §fYou can try to reach out to your friend through other methods of contact to verify if it's really them. Even so, you should try and verify that the link is from a reputable website - google the domain name to make sure you're landing at the right website.
[04:58:02] [NPC] Brigette: §fCongratulations! You aced the test!
[04:58:03] [NPC] Brigette: §fFill in the following information so that we can issue you a membership card.
[04:58:11] [NPC] Brigette: §c§lHEY! §fYou should §lnot§f be revealing personal or sensitive information!
[04:58:16] [NPC] Brigette: §fIt is a bad idea to share your personal details to others online.
[04:58:18]   §fTalk to the §eSecurity Clerk
[04:58:29] [NPC] Security Clerk: §f§fYour Safety Badge is ready! Your information has been digitally registered.
[04:58:33] [NPC] Security Clerk: §f§fThank you for joining the Safety Squad.
[04:58:36] [NPC] Security Clerk: §f§fYou're now a fully fledged Safety Advocate!
[04:58:40] [NPC] Security Clerk: §f§fHopefully there won't be more incidents happening around.
[04:58:42] [NPC] Security Clerk: §f§fOh, §dElizabeth§f wants to have a word with you.
[04:59:02]   §fTalk to §dElizabeth
[04:59:13] [NPC] Elizabeth: Hey [Wither_101 head]Wither_101!
[04:59:15] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fHow's your day?
[04:59:17] Select an option: [It was quite a hectic day.]
[04:59:22] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fThat's rough, buddy.
[04:59:24] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fSorry for roping you into all of this.
[04:59:27] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fAnyhow, sorry for the trouble again.
[04:59:30] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fI hope that the things you learnt today will help keep yourself and other people safe.
[04:59:36] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fRemember that safety in SkyBlock starts with you!
[04:59:36] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fAs an apology, I got something sweet for you.
[04:59:38] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fHere, take this §6Booster Cookie§f.
[04:59:40] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fIn case you're not aware of what a §6Booster Cookie§f does:
[04:59:44] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fA §6Booster Cookie§f grants you perks and access to some convenient commands for 4 days.
[04:59:49] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fIt grants you skill wisdom to level skills faster, for one.
[04:59:53] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fTake a good look at the §6Booster Cookie§f perks, you're in for a doozy.
[04:59:58] [NPC] Elizabeth: §fIf you're looking for more §6Booster Cookies§f, you can buy them from me with SkyBlock §aGems§f!
[04:59:58] Select an option: [Okay!]
